name: Ford Accessibility Reimbursement Program
description: Up to $1,000 reimbursement for adaptive vehicle equipment on new Ford vehicles
fullDescription: Ford's Accessibility Reimbursement Program (formerly Ford Mobility Motoring) offers up to $1,000 toward adaptive equipment, or up to $200 for alert hearing devices, lumbar support, or running boards, on a new Ford vehicle bought or leased from a US Ford dealer.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $1,000 reimbursement for installed adaptive equipment
- Up to $200 for alert hearing devices, lumbar support, or running boards
- Available on new Ford cars, vans, SUVs, and trucks purchased or leased from a US Ford dealer
- Wheelchair lift/ramp structural modifications must be done by a Ford Qualified Vehicle Modifier (QVM)
howToGetIt:
1. Purchase or lease a new Ford vehicle from a US Ford dealer
2. Have eligible adaptive equipment installed within one year of purchase or lease
3. Give your dealer the vehicle bill of sale and paid equipment invoice (both showing the VIN)
4. Your Ford dealer submits the reimbursement claim
5. Check is mailed 2-4 weeks after the dealer submits the claim
keywords: Ford, Ford Mobility Motoring, accessibility reimbursement, mobility, rebate, adaptive equipment, disability, vehicle modification, wheelchair accessible
